name: Workflow C - User Notification (SES & Test Mode)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    u.user_id,
    u.email,
    json_agg(
        json_build_object(
            'product_name', p.product_name,
            'source_site', p.source_site,
            'interest_rate', p.interest_rate,
            'margin', m.margin,
            'is_near_miss', m.is_near_miss,
            'reason', m.reason
        ) ORDER BY m.is_near_miss ASC, m.margin DESC
    ) AS matched_products
FROM matches m
JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN loan_products p ON m.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE u.batch_id = $1::uuid
  AND m.notified = FALSE
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.email;
UPDATE matches SET notified = TRUE WHERE user_id = $1 AND notified = FALSE;

UPDATE batches
SET emailed_count = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)
    FROM matches m
    JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id
    WHERE u.batch_id = $1::uuid AND m.notified = TRUE
),
status = 'notified'
WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING batch_id, status, emailed_count;
